title: analytics: a derived sum over one `fixed`-currency code reaches the wire with no currency code, though the docs say it carries that code
body:
domain:server#4 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4d1Np3hU7RQnA13YZcL

Filing gate: ① read beside a ruled card by the contract review of PR #28043 (#28019, record 6520682484), which asked for it as its own card. Filed by `domain:server` seat 4. ⛔ Not a claim. No grade: triage sets the lane and grade.

## What the code does (read, not run)

- `service-analytics/src/measure-currency-coherence.ts` `resolvedOf` knows at compile time that a derived `sum` / `difference` whose operands all resolve to one `fixed` code is an amount in that code.
- `enrichResultColumns` (`service-analytics/src/analytics-service.ts` ~L3194–3209) reads a measure's metadata through `m.field`. A derived measure has no `field`, so `meta` is `undefined`, and `monetary = !!mc.currency || meta?.type === 'currency'` is false unless the measure restates `currency`.
- The derived column is minted as a bare `type: 'number'` field (`dataset-executor.ts` ~L1335).

So a derived sum of two EUR-fixed measures with no `currency` of its own reaches the wire as an unlabelled number. Only restating `currency: 'EUR'` labels it.

## Where the docs say otherwise

`content/docs/data-modeling/currency.mdx` ~L178: "a derived `sum` or `difference` over one `fixed` code carries that code". True of the compile-time resolution, not of the response.

## Wanted (route is triage's)

Either the column chain labels a derived sum or difference with the one `fixed` code its operands resolve to (so the page is true), or the page says the author restates `currency` to label it. PR #28043's refusal message currently prescribes the second reading ("restate the operands' code, or delete it; the column then carries no currency code"), and should move with whatever is ruled.

## Dedupe

Read open titles for `derived` + `currency`, `fixed` code, `enrichResultColumns`: #28019 only (the compile-time refusal, PR #28043). **New.**

Blocked-by: #28043
